css: .t5-shell{position:relative;font:13px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#172033;background:#f7f8fb;border:1px solid #dfe3ea;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden}.t5-shell header p{margin:0;color:#6c7688;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;font-size:10px}.t5-shell header h2{margin:2px 0 12px;font-size:19px}.t5-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.t5-option{min-width:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dde2ea;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;overflow:hidden}.t5-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:9px}.t5-label strong{display:grid;place-items:center;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:7px;background:#172033;color:#fff}.t5-label span{font-weight:700;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.t5-row{border:1px solid #dfe3ea;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;min-width:0}.t5-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:8px;align-items:center}.t5-summary strong{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.t5-meta{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;color:#657084;font-size:11px}.t5-shell button{font:inherit}.t5-edit-btn,.t5-actions button{appearance:none;border:1px solid #cbd3df;background:#fff;border-radius:7px;padding:6px 9px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:650}.t5-edit-btn{white-space:nowrap}.t5-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;margin-top:9px}.t5-form label{display:grid;gap:3px;font-size:10px;color:#657084;min-width:0}.t5-form input,.t5-form select{width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box;border:1px solid #cbd3df;border-radius:7px;padding:7px;background:white;font:inherit;color:#172033}.t5-form .t5-wide{grid-column:1/-1}.t5-actions{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px}.t5-actions button[data-save]{background:#2749b8;color:white;border-color:#2749b8}.t5-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#17203366;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:14px;z-index:4}.t5-overlay[hidden]{display:none}.t5-modal{width:min(430px,100%);max-height:100%;overflow:auto;background:white;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid #cfd6e2;box-shadow:0 18px 50px #1720334a;padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box}.t5-modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.t5-modal-head button{appearance:none;border:0;background:transparent;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer}.t5-modal .t5-form{margin-top:8px}@media(max-width:690px){.t5-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.t5-form{grid-template-columns:1fr}.t5-form .t5-wide{grid-column:auto}.t5-actions{grid-column:auto}}
js: const base=(api.getState('tasks')||[])[0]||{id:'sample',title:'Prepare milestone review',owner:'Avery',status:'Doing',due:'2026-09-18'};let inlineTask={...base};let modalTask={...base};const inlineRow=root.querySelector('[data-inline-row]');const modalRow=root.querySelector('[data-modal-row]');const overlay=root.querySelector('[data-overlay]');const modalFormHost=root.querySelector('[data-modal-form]');function summary(host,task,onEdit){host.replaceChildren();const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='t5-summary';const title=document.createElement('strong');title.textContent=task.title||'(untitled)';const edit=document.createElement('button');edit.type='button';edit.className='t5-edit-btn';edit.textContent='Edit';edit.addEventListener('click',onEdit);const meta=document.createElement('div');meta.className='t5-meta';meta.style.gridColumn='1/-1';meta.textContent=(task.owner||'Unassigned')+' · '+(task.status||'—')+' · '+(task.due||'No due date');wrap.append(title,edit,meta);host.append(wrap);}function editor(task,onSave,onCancel){const form=document.createElement('div');form.className='t5-form';const make=(labelText,type,value,options)=>{const label=document.createElement('label');label.textContent=labelText;let field;if(type==='select'){field=document.createElement('select');options.forEach(v=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=v;o.textContent=v;if(v===value)o.selected=true;field.append(o);});}else{field=document.createElement('input');field.type=type;field.value=value||'';}label.append(field);return{label,field};};const title=make('Title','text',task.title);title.label.classList.add('t5-wide');const owner=make('Owner','text',task.owner);const status=make('Status','select',task.status,['Todo','Doing','Done']);const due=make('Due date','date',task.due);const actions=document.createElement('div');actions.className='t5-actions';const cancel=document.createElement('button');cancel.type='button';cancel.textContent='Cancel';const save=document.createElement('button');save.type='button';save.dataset.save='';save.textContent='Save';cancel.addEventListener('click',onCancel);save.addEventListener('click',()=>onSave({...task,title:title.field.value,owner:owner.field.value,status:status.field.value,due:due.field.value}));actions.append(cancel,save);form.append(title.label,owner.label,status.label,due.label,actions);return form;}function renderInline(){summary(inlineRow,inlineTask,()=>{inlineRow.append(editor(inlineTask,next=>{inlineTask=next;renderInline();api.log(5,'Inline prototype saved');},renderInline));});}function closeModal(){overlay.hidden=true;modalFormHost.replaceChildren();}function renderModal(){summary(modalRow,modalTask,()=>{modalFormHost.replaceChildren(editor(modalTask,next=>{modalTask=next;renderModal();closeModal();api.log(5,'Popup prototype saved');},closeModal));overlay.hidden=false;});}root.querySelector('[data-modal-close]').addEventListener('click',closeModal);overlay.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===overlay)closeModal();});renderInline();renderModal();
